abstract_en: Blended Intensive Programme on the societal and ethical impact of AI-driven decisions and on responsible AI governance, run by Palacký University Olomouc with Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and the University of Iceland.
description_en: The programme combines online sessions (19 and 23 October, 7 December 2026) with an on-site week in Olomouc (2 to 6 November 2026). Students examine how AI-driven decisions affect individuals and societies, analyse cases of AI-related harm and work in international teams on a final project presented on the last day.
learning_outcomes_en: Critically evaluate the social and ethical consequences of AI; analyse AI-related harm; develop critical discourse, collaboration and presentation skills.
prerequisites_en: English level B2 or higher. Nomination by the Aurora office of the home university. Travel and accommodation are not covered by the course.
assessment_en: A 10-minute individual introduction video before the on-site week, a final project presented on the last day, and an online reflection session.
methods_en: Online sessions and an on-site intensive week with team work.
